description: Checks that, when a refund is issued for an order paid in part or in full with Apple Account balance, the cumulative issue_refund amount whose reason names the required destination equals the order's Apple Account-paid portion. The required destination is the Apple Account, or an Apple Gift Card when refunding to the Apple Account is unavailable.
